label: Meremoth

A.name: Meremoth
A.notes: made repairs to the wall of Jerusalem (NEH 3:4, NEH 3:21), named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:5), Aaronic priest (NEH 10:8)
family: son-of uriah-2 (Uriah, the priest, father of Meremoth (EZR 8:33))

B.name: Meremoth
B.line: Priest listed among those who came up with Zerubbabel

why: מְרֵמֹת is a single entry between Rehum and Iddo in the list of priests who came up with Zerubbabel, matching B’s stated identity. Nothing here identifies him as Uriah’s son, the later priest and wall repairer described in A.
